protocol.adapter_init_seed_note: Rengu-Flow applies train_seed after adapter construction; use the seeded launcher in command_template to seed LoRA initialization first.
protocol.interpretation: train/loss is minibatch training loss; use only train_eval/loss for the train side of the gap.

optimizer_integration.resolver: Rengu-Flow resolves fully-qualified optimizer.type via importlib

train_eval_hooks.Nekaon: implements eval()/train(); Rengu-Flow calls these around eval
train_eval_hooks.Adakaon: no eval()/train() hook; Rengu-Flow skips optimizer mode transition
train_eval_hooks.Rakaon: no eval()/train() hook; Rengu-Flow skips optimizer mode transition

optimizer_integration.note: Nekaon must be put in eval mode before validation/checkpoint export so its lookahead view is removed; current Rengu-Flow's evaluate() does this when hasattr(optimizer, 'eval').
